title: The Ambassador Program and New Categories
lessons: The player learns that a college student posting PRIME can be part of the brand's formal ambassador program.
The player bought Hydration before and now receives marketing for PRIME's growing set of product categories.

text: The player learns that a college student posting PRIME can be part of the brand's formal ambassador program.

entry-first-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: Is that student just a fan?

entry-first-2.speaker: PRIME
text: Maybe. They could also be one of my ambassadors.

entry-first-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: What does that actually mean?

entry-first-4.speaker: PRIME
text: Product, merch, competitions, private community, career opportunities. They help put me into campus life on purpose.

choice-first.speaker: PRIME
text: What do you make of that?

choices.text: That is a smart way to get into a real community.
So the recommendation is also work.
I would rather hear from a friend who is not on the brand team.

first-1.speaker: PRIME
text: Exactly. One person with real campus relationships can do more than a poster.

first-2.speaker: PRIME
text: Yes. If they are an ambassador, remember they are getting something from me for posting.

first-3.speaker: PRIME
text: Fair. Paid enthusiasm is still paid enthusiasm.
The player bought Hydration before and now receives marketing for PRIME's growing set of product categories.

entry-return-1.speaker: PRIME
text: Hydration, Energy, Shake, Rapid Rehydration, sticks. Pick another aisle.

entry-return-2.speaker: PLAYER
text: I bought one bottle and you decided I wanted the family reunion.

entry-return-3.speaker: PRIME
text: You gave me an email address and proof you buy the brand.

entry-return-4.speaker: PLAYER
text: Very romantic.

entry-return-5.speaker: PRIME
text: I would like more of your fridge.

choice-return.speaker: PRIME
text: What do you make of that?

choices.text: I like having more options from a brand I already know.
I am not following you into every category automatically.
I wanted one drink, not a whole PRIME lifestyle.

return-1.speaker: PRIME
text: Familiarity makes the next trial easier. I will take it.

return-2.speaker: PRIME
text: You should not. A logo does not make every format right for you.

return-3.speaker: PRIME
text: Fine. Keep one shelf.

return-3-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: Thank you.

return-3-2.speaker: PRIME
text: I will think about the other shelves privately.
